question: Can the validated task-typed carrier programs be compiled into exact, gauge-invariant weight contractions that expose which components can write the L9H1/H4 task subspaces and whether shared MLP3/4/8 reuse common weight-computation modes?

frozen_design.subspaces: Frozen has/had rank-18 and is/was rank-3 L9H1/H4 value-bank bases.
frozen_design.read_map: For task basis U, R = U^T block_rows(W_V^L9,H1/H4).
frozen_design.attention_map: A = R W_O^head for each attention component in the pruned path.
frozen_design.stored_manifest: For every upstream layer 0-8 component, store gauge-invariant scores, exact tensor/map SHA256, shapes, ranks and spectra; formulas plus frozen checkpoint and basis hashes regenerate every coefficient.
frozen_design.shared_mode_test: Compare row spaces of flattened has/had and is/was tensors for MLP3, MLP4 and MLP8 by principal cosines.

predictions.pred_a_authority_basis_rank_gauge_finite: Authorities and ranks reproduce; direct factor and tensor contractions agree within 1e-4; all values and hashes are valid.
predictions.pred_b_shared_backbone_is_top_weight_con: MLP3, MLP4 and MLP8 are all in the top six normalized tensor scores for both task read maps.
predictions.pred_c_shared_backbone_reuses_weight_mod: Every shared MLP has at least one cross-task tensor-row principal cosine >=0.50.
predictions.pred_d_pruned_attention_edges_are_weight: Every attention component retained in either pruned program has positive finite normalized write score to its task read map.
predictions.pred_e_zero_causal_fit_and_exact_price: No model forward, causal example evaluation, fit, backward pass, or update.

decision: screen publishes the manifest as the weight-level compiler boundary; null retains exact tensors but rejects either top-connectivity or shared-mode reuse; invalid on authority, rank, gauge, replay, finiteness, hash, or price failure
